column1: # Reviewed semantic identities for the contiguous GAME effect-pool construction band.
# Every row was checked with image-qualified address, disassembly/CFG, caller, callee,
# string, data-reference, relocation, adjacent-function, source/history, match, and
# vendored/FID evidence. Address contiguity supports the current unit campaign but is
# not asserted as an original source-file boundary.
